name: Eric Trump

lean.basis: Campaigned for his father in 2016, 2020 and 2024; says he would not rule out running for office himself.

sources.title: Eric and Lara Trump won’t “rule anything out” about running for office — Washington Examiner

current_role: Executive vice president of the Trump Organization; co-founder of World Liberty Financial and co-founder and chief strategy officer of American Bitcoin
summary: Eric Trump, the president’s third child, has run the Trump Organization with his brother Donald Jr. since their father returned to politics, and leads much of the family’s crypto business: he is a listed co-founder of World Liberty Financial and a manager of its holding company, and co-founded the bitcoin miner American Bitcoin, whose collapse in value erased an estimated $600 million from the family fortune in 2026. He has said he would not rule out running for office.
